en.bdb: One Oankaar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor
One Oankaar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: aadh purakh aadhes kar aadh purakh aadhes karaiaa|

en.bdb: The Guru bowed before the Lord and the primal Lord made the whole world bow before the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਏਕੰਕਾਰ ਅਕਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਨਾਉ ਸਦਵਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: eka(n)kaar akaar kar gur govi(n)dh naau sadhavaiaa|

en.bdb: The formless Brahm assuming (human) form has got himself called Guru (Har) Gobind.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਸਰਗੁਣ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: paarabraham pooran braham niragun saragun alakh lakhaiaa|

en.bdb: Assuming form and being formless at the same time, the transcendental perfect Brahm has made His unmanifest form manifest.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਅਛਲੁ ਛਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat aaraadhiaa bhagat vachhal hoi achhal chhalaiaa|

en.bdb: The holy congregation adored Him; and being in love with the devotees He, the undeceivable, got deluded (and became manifest in the form of Guru).

verses.gurmukhi: ਓਅੰਕਾਰ ਅਕਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਇਕ ਕਵਾਉ ਪਸਾਉ ਪਸਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: oa(n)kaar akaar kar ik kavaau pasaau pasaiaa|

en.bdb: The Maar assuming form created the whole world by His one commanding vibration.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡੁ ਕਰੋੜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: rom rom vich rakhion kar brahama(n)dd karoR samaiaa|

en.bdb: In His each trichome He contained millions of universes.
The sadhus adore the Lord in the form of the Guru's feet.
